answer:
Verdict: no

No thread clearly stands out as hogging a CPU. Over the whole trace (0–30,514.7 ms), **calc-2 (TID 633144)** used the most among the leading measured workers: **3,101.5 ms of CPU**, or **10.34%** of its 29,922.2 ms lifetime. That is effectively tied with **calc-0 (TID 633142)** at 3,098.6 ms (10.33%); the other measured workers were also close, at about 10.2–10.3%. Calc-2’s busiest 100 ms window was **1,694.0–1,794.0 ms**, when it used 11.0 ms of CPU (11.0%).
